cues.en: Why is it that I asked you to freeze the attention layers and the embeddings layer and not the MLP?

cues.zh: 為何除了最後分類層，只留下 MLP 層可訓練？

cues.en: So the answer to the embeddings is that we already have the trained embeddings, and we trust that they are well trained.
cues.zh: 嵌入層的答案是，它已經訓練過，我們相信它訓練得很好。

cues.en: We do not want to spend a lot of energy and time and gradient computational power to adjust this matrix.

cues.en: The answer to that question has to do with a kind of division of labor between what the attention sublayers
cues.zh: 答案與某種分工有關，也就是注意力子層

cues.en: do and what the MLP sublayers do, and what the attention sublayers are really good at is identifying
cues.zh: 和 MLP 子層各自的作用。注意力子層很擅長辨識

cues.en: patterns that are distributed across different tokens and integrating those patterns.
cues.zh: 分散在不同詞元之間的模式，並把它們整合起來。

cues.en: In contrast, what the MLP layers are really good at is identifying spaces in the data set where we
cues.zh: 相較之下，MLP 層很擅長辨識資料集中的空間，

cues.en: can do some linear classification and linear separation.
cues.zh: 讓我們能在其中進行線性分類與線性分離。

cues.en: So we get this big expansion into this huge space where non-linear features might become linearly separable in that space.
cues.zh: 它把維度大幅擴張到更大的空間，原本非線性的特徵，可能在那個空間變成線性可分。

cues.en: And then we can project back down to a smaller dimensional space while preserving the linear separability.
cues.zh: 接著再投影回較小維度，同時保留線性可分性。

cues.en: And that is what the MLP layers are good for and that kind of linear separability is exactly what we want this model to do.
cues.zh: 這是 MLP 層的長處，而這種線性可分性，正是我們希望模型達成的。

cues.en: We want it to classify text, which is very nonlinear, into either positive or negative reviews, which ultimately is going to be a linear output at the end.
cues.zh: 我們想把非常非線性的文字，分成正面或負面評論，最後由線性輸出層輸出。

cues.zh: 確實讓學習曲線稍微平順了一些。

cues.en: I did not try running a smaller learning rate, so if you try that, then you can post your results to the Q&A and let us all know what the outcome is.
cues.zh: 我沒有試較小的學習率；如果你試了，可以把結果貼到問答區，讓大家知道。

cues.en: You can also try freezing the entire Bert model and also only training the classification layer.
cues.zh: 也可以把整個 BERT 凍結，只訓練分類層。

cues.en: I can tell you that I tried that and it was an absolute catastrophe.
cues.zh: 我可以告訴你，我試過，結果慘不忍睹。

cues.en: So you're welcome to try it if you like.
cues.zh: 但如果願意，還是可以試試。

cues.en: You can also try freezing the MLP layers and training the attention layers, as I mentioned earlier in the video.
cues.zh: 也可以凍結 MLP 層，訓練注意力層，前面提過。

cues.en: That's not really such a theoretically sensible thing to do, but you can try it anyway.
cues.zh: 理論上這不算非常合理，但仍然可以嘗試。

cues.en: And there are two things.
cues.zh: 只有兩件事，

cues.en: Only two things that I absolutely do not want you to try.
cues.zh: 我絕對不要你現在嘗試。

cues.en: That is including a learning rate scheduler or applying gradient clipping.
cues.zh: 也就是加入學習率排程器，或套用梯度裁剪。

cues.en: I will describe exactly what these two things are in the next video and in a code challenge.
cues.zh: 下一支影片與程式挑戰會詳細說明它們是什麼。

cues.en: After that, we will explore these two possibilities.
cues.zh: 之後，我們會探索這兩種做法。

cues.en: Anyway, these are just a few suggestions in case you want some inspiration.
cues.zh: 總之，如果你需要靈感，以上是一些建議。

cues.en: The two main applications of language models are text generation and classification.
cues.zh: 語言模型兩個主要應用，是文字生成與分類。

cues.en: But basically anything you want to do that involves processing text or code or really anything that
cues.zh: 但基本上，任何處理文字、程式碼，或任何能

cues.en: can be temporally sequenced in tokenized form can be done with a language model or at least a transformer type architecture.
cues.zh: 依時間順序表示成詞元的事，都能用語言模型，或至少 Transformer 類型架構處理。

cues.en: Another point I want to bring up here is that in this video, I only focused on loss and accuracy, mainly just for convenience.
cues.zh: 另一點是，這支影片只關注損失與準確率，主要是為了方便。

cues.en: If you've taken my deep learning course or another machine learning course, then you'll also know that
cues.zh: 如果上過我的深度學習課，或其他機器學習課，應該也知道，

cues.en: there are several other measures of performance that are different from accuracy and also quite insightful.
cues.zh: 除了準確率，還有其他很有洞見的表現指標。

cues.en: So I'm not exploring them here, but I do recommend looking into other performance metrics if you are developing models like this for real world applications.
cues.zh: 這裡不深入探索，但如果要開發這類實際應用模型，我建議進一步了解其他評估指標。
